_methodology: Hand-annotated by visual inspection of data/pid/diagram.pdf page 2 (AC-746 After-Cooler / E-742 NGL Preheat Exchanger sheet) rendered at 300 DPI, cropped into three overlapping regional clusters for legibility. This page had zero ground truth of any kind before this file -- unlike pages 0/1, category coverage and tag accuracy on page 2 were never measured at all this whole session, despite AC-746/E-742's vector-signature detection being investigated (and rejected) in src/pid_extraction/vector_equipment.py. Same digit-corruption caveat already documented elsewhere in this README applies here too, and is handled the same way: excluded rather than guessed. Two specific items excluded for that reason: a valve read as either 'MV-742-06' or 'MV-742-08' (ambiguous at this resolution) near the AC-746 fan motor, and a second circle labeled 'TW 742' near PIT-742 that may be a real second physical thermowell sharing that loop number or may be a misread of a different tag -- not confident enough to assert either way. Also excluded: MV-742-D2 (real valve, but a non-standard letter+digit third segment TAG_CORE's numeric-only extension doesn't cover -- a real, disclosed gap in the tag convention this project's regex handles, not a ground-truth omission). Not a claim of exhaustiveness -- this is a real, substantial sample (29 components), not a full inventory of every symbol on the sheet.
